messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "life-threatening if not recognized and treated"
set: ["life-threatening if not recognized and treated", "can cause serious and life-threatening irregular heartbeat", "no recognized potential for dependence or abuse", "may cause life-threatening withdrawal symptoms in newborn", "not known if could harm a nursing baby", "may not be able to use if have glaucoma", "safety and effectiveness not established in children and teenagers for any condition other than OCD", "this list is not complete and many other drugs may interact", "use for extended period during pregnancy can cause life-threatening withdrawal symptoms in newborn baby", "do not perform tasks if causes confusion, mental impairment, or drowsiness", "safety and efficacy beyond 16 weeks of therapy have not been established", "blood pressure can rise sharply if not started with alpha blocker", "safety and effectiveness not established in children under 6 years of age", "this is not a complete list of side effects and others may occur", "may not be safe", "symptoms usually not serious"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
